# ADR 0011 - Run the webinar before any paid ads

**Date:** 2026-09-24 · **Status:** proposed

## Decision

Paid ads for the joint campaign wait until the webinar itself has run once.

## Why

Ads without a webinar to point at converted badly the one time we tried it, on a different
campaign.

## What would change this

The webinar itself needing a paid-ads push to hit a minimum registration count.
